title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_restore_completed}
description: Phase 8 §8.3 — emitted by maint.backup.v1 once the operator-driven `restore` pipeline finishes (success OR failure — branch by `exit_code`). Notification only. Mirrored as a row in `maint_audit_log` (right-to-restore traceability).

exit_code.description: 0 on success; non-zero is the surface code from the failing stage (`pg_restore` exit, `dr_key_required`, `live_overwrite_requires_confirm`, etc.).

outcome.description: Closed taxonomy mirroring the failure surface tokens.

verify_summary.description: Per-table row counts from the post-restore `verify.sql` run (omitted on non-ok outcomes).
